subject: split column in dataframe delineated by ','

messages.author: c102ef7f5617067f
messages.subject: split column in dataframe delineated by ','
parts:
I have a dataframe that looks like this:

myDF <- data.frame(
  v1=c(NA, 'adult 1', 'juv 1, adult 2', 'juv 1', 
       'adult 1, juv 10', NA, 'adult 10, juv 10'))

Where v1 is delineated by ',', I need the contents moved to a second column of a dataframe. The dataframe needs to look like this:

dfNeeded <- data.frame(
  v1=c(NA, 'adult 1', 'juv 1', 'juv 1', 'adult 1', NA, 'adult 10'),
  v2=c(NA, NA, 'adult 2', NA, 'juv 10', NA, 'juv 10'))

I believe this can be done using reshape but I'm not sure exactly how. Some help would be appreciated.

> I have a dataframe that looks like this:
>
> myDF <- data.frame(
> v1=c(NA, 'adult 1', 'juv 1, adult 2', 'juv 1',
> 'adult 1, juv 10', NA, 'adult 10, juv 10'))
>
> Where v1 is delineated by ',', I need the contents moved to a second column
> of a dataframe. The dataframe needs to look like this:
>
> dfNeeded <- data.frame(
> v1=c(NA, 'adult 1', 'juv 1', 'juv 1', 'adult 1', NA, 'adult 10'),
> v2=c(NA, NA, 'adult 2', NA, 'juv 10', NA, 'juv 10'))
>
> I believe this can be done using reshape but I'm not sure exactly how. Some
> help would be appreciated.

You want the colsplit function

library("reshape2")
dfNeeded <- colsplit(myDF$v1, ", ", c("v1", "v2"))

For the NA entries, this puts "" in v2, so to make those NA as well, add

dfNeeded$v2[dfNeeded$v2 == ""] <- NA


> dput(dfNeeded)
structure(list(v1 = c(NA, "adult 1", "juv 1", "juv 1", "adult 1",
NA, "adult 10"), v2 = c(NA, NA, "adult 2", NA, "juv 10", NA,
"juv 10")), .Names = c("v1", "v2"), row.names = c(NA, -7L), class =
"data.frame")
> dfNeeded
v1 v2
1 <NA> <NA>
2 adult 1 <NA>
3 juv 1 adult 2
4 juv 1 <NA>
5 adult 1 juv 10
6 <NA> <NA>
7 adult 10 juv 10
